sections.name: Wines and Hard Ciders
items: This was our first hard cider. The Original is dry, and the absence of other flavors makes it easier to pick up on the oakiness of the barrel. This is available as a wine and a hard cider.
Apple Wine is our driest wine. It is similar to our Original, but lighter and more dry. This is only available as a wine.
Spiced Apple is made with mulling spices. This is slightly sweet. It is a staple fall time wine for many. This is only available in a wine.
Spider Cider is a fan favorite. It is sweet with pumpkin spices. It is also great in a hot toddy, or warmed on its own. This is only available as a wine.
Strawberry Bliss is our sweetest wine. It is an apple strawberry, and very strawberry forward. This is only available as a wine.
Lucky Lion was one of our first hard ciders. It is dry, crisp, and is sometimes described as being similar to a scotch. This is available in a wine and a hard cider.

Blackout is our most popular out of all our wines and hard ciders. It is almost reminiscent of a whiskey, with strong oak flavors. It is on the dryer side of our flavors, and is a much bolder flavor than any of the lineup. This is available in a wine and a hard cider.

Boomerang is a classic apple cranberry. It is very tart and is on the sweeter end of our flavors. This is a great place to start with our wines and hard ciders if you’re a cranberry fan. This is available in a wine and a hard cider.
Blueberry Spinner is apple blueberry. It is very sweet, slightly tart, and very blueberry forward. This is only available as a wine.
Goodfella is apple blackberry. It is very sweet and slightly tart. This is typically a favorite of fans of sweet grape wines. This is available as a wine and a hard cider.
Yellow Jacket is apple orange. Contrary to the name, it does not contain honey. It is slightly sweet, with a bite from the orange. This is available as a wine and a hard cider.
Cider House Blend is a perfect middle of the road choice. It has apple, orange, and cranberry. It Is slightly sweet and tart. This is only available as a wine.
Apple Raspberry is sweet, but very tart. It has a stronger bite than some of our other wines. This is only available as a wine.
